01 / The challenge

The challenge for agriculture & farming.

Norfolk is farming country. Agricultural contractors, estates and suppliers run pickups, vans and trailers that face mud, hedge-cutting and regular pressure washing. Graphics need to be tough, simple and easy to read.

01

Mud and pressure washing

Farm vehicles get filthy and cleaned hard. Edges need to be sealed.

02

Pickups and trailers

Most farm fleets are pickups, trailers and the odd van.

03

Long distances

Contractors cover big areas. The number needs to be readable.

06 / Design tips

Build the layout around the job.

01

Keep it high on the body

Mud splashes the lower panels. Put key details higher up.

02

Seal the edges

Ask for edge sealing if vehicles are pressure washed often.

03

Brand the trailer

Trailers are often left in fields and gateways. Give them your name and number.

Before you book

Good to know.

Will graphics survive pressure washing?

Yes, with laminated film and sealed edges. Keep the lance at a sensible distance from edges.

Can you brand livestock trailers?

Yes. Send photos and dimensions.

Do you brand tractors?

We can add logos to tractor panels and cabs. Send photos of the areas you want branded.
